DNA end resection.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
DNA end resection.question: The _____ was Process involved in DNA repair.
DNA end resection.fact: DNA end resection, also called 5′–3′ ("five-prime to three-prime") degradation, is a biochemical process where the blunt end of a section of double-stranded DNA (dsDNA) is modified by cutting away some nucleotides from the 5' end to produce a 3' single-stranded sequence. Double-strand breaks (DSBs) can occur at any phase of the cell cycle, causing DNA end resection and repair activities to take place, but they are also normal intermediates in mitotic recombination.

DNA end resection.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
DNA end resection.question: Three mechanisms exist to repair DSBs: non-homologous end joining (_____), microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ), and homologous recombination HR
DNA end resection.fact: Three mechanisms exist to repair DSBs: non-homologous end joining (NHEJ), microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ), and homologous recombination HR. Of these, only NHEJ does not rely on DNA end resection.

DNA end resection.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
DNA end resection.question: Out of the three mechanisms for DSB repair, _____ and HR repair mechanisms are the dominant pathways
DNA end resection.fact: Three mechanisms exist to repair DSBs: non-homologous end joining (NHEJ), microhomology-mediated end joining (MMEJ), and homologous recombination HR. Of these, only NHEJ does not rely on DNA end resection.

DNA end resection.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
DNA end resection.question: The _____ mechanism functions by ligating two different DSBs with high fidelity, while HR relies on a homologous template to repair DSB ends
DNA end resection.fact: Of these, only NHEJ does not rely on DNA end resection. Out of the three mechanisms for DSB repair, NHEJ and HR repair mechanisms are the dominant pathways.

DNA end resection.subject: Animal Husbandry & Dairy
DNA end resection.question: The _____ pathway is involved throughout the cell cycle, but it is critical to DNA repair during the G1 phase
DNA end resection.fact: DSBs that have not begun DNA end resection can be ligated by the NHEJ pathway, but resection of a few nucleotides inhibits the NHEJ pathway and commits DNA repair to the HR pathway. The NHEJ pathway is involved throughout the cell cycle, but it is critical to DNA repair during the G1 phase.
